# <span class="en">Integrated findings and discussion</span><span class="zh">综合发现与讨论</span> {#sec-integration}

## <span class="en">What the methods say together</span><span class="zh">各方法合起来说明了什么</span>

::: {.en}
Each method answers a narrower question than the one a reader brings to a
conflict map, and the answers are most useful read together. @tbl-synthesis
lines them up for the regions that recur through the report.
:::

::: {.zh}
每种方法回答的问题都比读者面对冲突地图时心中的问题更窄,把它们放在一起读才最有用。
@tbl-synthesis 把各方法对报告中反复出现的地区的结论并列在一起。
:::

```{r}
#| label: tbl-synthesis
#| tbl-cap: "<span class='en'>Synthesis by region. LISA and Gi\\* refer to the whole-period totals of all conflict events; EHSA to the period-conditional classification; diffusion to the onset and Markov analysis.</span><span class='zh'>按地区的综合。LISA 与 Gi\\* 指全部冲突事件的整期总量;EHSA 指按期条件化的分类;扩散指爆发与马尔可夫分析。</span>"

tribble(
  ~Region, ~`LISA / Gi*`, ~EHSA, ~`Trend and diffusion`,
  "Dry Zone core (Sagaing–Magway–Mandalay border)",
    "High-High and hot spot, survives FDR",
    "Consecutive or chronic sporadic hot spots since late 2021",
    "Peak 2022–23, declining since; persistent",
  "South and east edge of the Dry Zone (Chauk, Nyaung-U, Taungtha, Meiktila, Kyaukse, Pyinoolwin)",
    "Mostly not significant over the whole period",
    "New consecutive hot spots, runs beginning 2024–25",
    "Spreading outwards from the core: adjacent onsets",
  "South-east (Kayin, Mon, eastern Bago, Tanintharyi)",
    "High-High chain, does not survive FDR; strongest for remote violence",
    "Sporadic and some consecutive hot spots",
    "Rising; Kayin highest in 2025",
  "Rakhine",
    "Not significant over the whole period; High-High in 2024",
    "Mostly sporadic; Ramree oscillating hot spot",
    "Abrupt escalation from late 2023 (offensive)",
  "Northern Shan",
    "Mixed; Low-Low in the Wa area",
    "Kyaukme consecutive hot spot; Lashio oscillating cold spot",
    "Episodic: offensives in late 2023 and 2024",
  "Yangon",
    "Low-Low, survives FDR",
    "Consecutive cold spots with downward trend",
    "Active in 2021–22, suppressed since",
  "Eastern Shan hills and Wa",
    "Low-Low, survives FDR",
    "Persistent and consecutive cold spots",
    "Outside the war throughout (or under-reported)",
  "Isolated high-conflict townships (Kawkareik, Kale, Hpakant)",
    "Not significant",
    "No pattern detected",
    "Invisible to neighbourhood statistics"
) |>
  gt() |>
  cols_width(Region ~ px(210)) |>
  tab_options(table.font.size = px(12.5))
```

::: {.en}
Three conclusions follow.

**The geography of the war has a stable core and moving edges.** The Dry
Zone, where the post-coup resistance was strongest among the Bamar majority,
is the centre of the conflict on every measure and every year to 2023, and
remains a chronic hot spot. What moves are the edges: south and east from the
core towards central Myanmar and the Mandalay–Lashio road, and the separate
fronts in Rakhine, northern Shan and the south-east, which opened at
different times. That is why global Moran's I fell after 2023 even though
total violence did not: the conflict became less concentrated, not less
intense.

**Hot spots grow from existing hot spots.** The EHSA finds almost no hot spot
appearing from nowhere, and the value-added analysis gives the reason: after
the nationwide outbreak of 2021, conflict entered new townships only from
next door, and escalation in any township depends strongly on its
neighbours. The new consecutive hot spots on the edges of the Dry Zone are
the visible result of that process.

**Calm is not uniform.** The persistent cold zone of the eastern Shan hills
and the newer cold zone of Yangon look alike on a map and mean opposite
things. The first is a region that has largely stayed out of the war. The
second is a city where the resistance was put down.
:::

::: {.zh}
由此得出三个结论。

**战争的地理格局有一个稳定的核心和不断移动的边缘。** 干燥带是政变后缅族抵抗最强的
地方,在 2023 年之前的每一年、每一项指标上都是冲突的中心,至今仍是长期热点。移动的
是边缘:从核心向南、向东移向缅甸中部与曼德勒–腊戍公路;以及在不同时间打开的若开、
掸邦北部与东南方向的几条独立前线。这解释了为何 2023 年后全局 Moran's I 下降而暴力
总量并未下降:冲突变得**不那么集中**,而不是**不那么激烈**。

**热点从已有的热点中生长出来。** EHSA 几乎没有发现凭空出现的热点,附加价值分析给出了
原因:在 2021 年的全国性爆发之后,冲突只从**隔壁**进入新的镇区,而任何镇区的升级都
强烈依赖于其邻居。干燥带边缘那些新的连续热点,正是这一过程的可见结果。

**平静并不均一。** 掸邦东部山地的持续冷区与仰光较新的冷区在地图上看起来一样,含义
却相反。前者是一个基本置身于战争之外的地区;后者是一座抵抗力量**被镇压**的城市。
:::

## <span class="en">What neighbourhood statistics cannot see</span><span class="zh">邻域统计量看不见什么</span>

::: {.en}
Three of the five townships with the most conflict events, Kawkareik, Kale
and Hpakant, are not significant under local Moran's I or Gi\*, and their
EHSA class is "no pattern detected". Each is a high-conflict township whose
neighbours are much quieter. Local Moran's I could in principle flag them as
High-Low outliers, but with only five or six neighbours, a single extreme
township among moderate ones does not reach significance. Gi\* sums the
neighbourhood, so one township's events are diluted by its neighbours'.
This is a property of the methods, not an error, and it means a hot spot map
must not be read as a list of the most violent places. For operational use
the cluster maps should always be read alongside the count maps of
@sec-dist.
:::

::: {.zh}
冲突事件最多的五个镇区中,有三个,即高加力、葛礼与帕敢,在局部 Moran's I 与 Gi\* 下
都不显著,EHSA 类别也是「未检测到模式」。它们每一个都是冲突很高、而邻居要平静得多的
镇区。局部 Moran's I 原则上可以把它们标为「高-低」异常值,但只有五六个邻居时,一个
处于中等邻居之间的极端镇区达不到显著性。Gi\* 对邻域求和,所以一个镇区的事件会被
邻居稀释。这是方法本身的性质,并非错误;但它意味着**热点地图不能被读成「最暴力
地点」的名单**。在实际应用中,聚集地图应当始终与 @sec-dist 的计数地图一起阅读。
:::

## <span class="en">Geovisualisation and geocommunication choices</span><span class="zh">地理可视化与地理传达的选择</span> {#sec-geocomm}

::: {.en}
The figures follow a few rules, chosen so that a reader who skips the text
can still read the maps correctly.

- **One colour, one meaning.** Red is always more conflict or a hot spot,
  blue always less or a cold spot, and the same palette is used for the same
  statistic everywhere: the LISA quadrants, the Gi\* classes and the EHSA
  classes each have one fixed colour scheme (`R/utils.R`). In the LISA maps
  the outlier quadrants are paler than the cluster quadrants, so an outlier
  is not mistaken for a cluster.
- **Significance is shown, not implied.** Non-significant townships are
  pale grey, and townships that survive FDR correction carry a heavy
  outline, so the strength of evidence is visible on the map itself. In the
  EHSA maps "no pattern detected" is left blank, since it is not a result.
- **Comparison by small multiples.** Variables, years and specifications
  are compared in panels that share classes, which keeps differences between
  panels meaningful.
- **Counts beside statistics.** Every local statistic map has a count map to
  set against it (@sec-dist), and the heat strip of @fig-cube shows the raw
  space-time cube that EHSA summarises.
- **Captions that state the reading.** Each commentary block names the
  conclusion first, in bold, and then the evidence for it.
:::

::: {.zh}
本报告的图形遵循几条规则,目的是让跳过正文的读者也能正确读图。

- **一种颜色,一种含义。** 红色始终表示冲突更多或热点,蓝色始终表示冲突更少或冷点;
  同一统计量在各处使用同一调色板:LISA 象限、Gi\* 类别与 EHSA 类别各有一套固定配色
  (见 `R/utils.R`)。在 LISA 地图中,异常值象限比聚集象限颜色更浅,避免把异常值
  误读为聚集。
- **显著性被显示,而不是被暗示。** 不显著的镇区为浅灰色,通过 FDR 校正的镇区加粗
  描边,因此证据强度直接体现在地图上。EHSA 地图中「未检测到模式」留白,因为它不是
  一个结果。
- **用小多图做比较。** 变量、年份与设定都在共享分级的子图中比较,使子图之间的差异
  有意义。
- **统计量旁附计数。** 每一幅局部统计量地图都有一幅计数地图可供对照(@sec-dist),
  @fig-cube 的热力条带则展示了 EHSA 所概括的原始时空立方体。
- **说明直接给出读法。** 每段解读先以粗体点明结论,再给出证据。
:::
